entries.zh: 要不我们……？（W 开头，提建议）

examples.en: Why don't we start with a small prototype and see how it goes?
examples.zh: 要不我们先做个小原型，看看效果？

situation.zh: 大家争论了半天哪个库更快，你提议直接跑个基准测试。
situation.en: Why don't we just run a quick benchmark and compare?

entries.note: 是提建议，不是真的在问“为什么不”。比 What if we 更有倾向性。

entries.zh: 我倾向于……（l 开头的动词）

examples.en: I'd lean towards the second option because it's easier to roll back.
examples.zh: 我倾向于第二个方案，因为更容易回滚。

situation.zh: 经理问你：两个方案里你更想选哪个？你更偏向自研，但并不坚持。
situation.en: I'd lean towards building it ourselves, but I'm open to either.

entries.note: 表示有偏好但不坚持。美式多写 toward，英式多写 towards。

examples.en: It might be worth adding a dashboard before we roll this out.
examples.zh: 上线之前也许值得先加个监控面板。

situation.zh: 讨论新功能时，你建议先问问客服团队用户都在抱怨什么。
situation.en: It might be worth checking with the support team first.

entries.note: worth 后面接动名词（-ing）。非常委婉的建议。

entries.zh: 故意唱反调（为了检验方案）

examples.en: Let me play devil's advocate for a second: what if the vendor shuts down?
examples.zh: 我故意唱个反调：万一供应商倒闭了怎么办？

situation.zh: 大家一致同意迁移到新框架，你想故意提出反面意见，看看方案是否站得住。
situation.en: Just to play devil's advocate, what do we lose if we stay on the current framework?

entries.note: 先声明自己是在唱反调，这样提出反对意见不会显得针对人。

entries.term: I don't feel strongly either way.
entries.zh: 我两边都行，没有特别的倾向。

examples.en: I don't feel strongly either way, so I'm happy to go with your approach.
examples.zh: 我两边都行，所以用你的方案我没意见。

situation.zh: 同事问你：变量命名用哪种风格？你觉得都可以。
situation.en: I don't feel strongly either way. Let's go with whatever the team already uses.

entries.note: 反过来，I feel strongly about this 表示这一点你很坚持。

examples.en: Let's go over the action items before we end the meeting.
examples.zh: 结束会议前我们过一遍待办事项。

situation.zh: 会议快结束了，你想确认：你这边的待办是更新文档和联系安全团队。
situation.en: So my action items are to update the docs and reach out to the security team.

entries.note: 每个 action item 通常要有负责人（owner）和截止时间。

examples.en: To recap, we're going with option two and shipping it behind a flag.
examples.zh: 总结一下，我们选方案二，加开关上线。

situation.zh: 会议最后你来总结结论：先修登录 bug，重构推到下个迭代。
situation.en: To recap, we'll fix the login bug first and move the refactor to the next sprint.

entries.note: recap 是 recapitulate 的缩写，口语和邮件都常用。也可以说 To sum up, ...

entries.zh: 大家理解一致（国内常说“对齐”）

examples.en: I want to make sure we're all on the same page before we start coding.
examples.zh: 开始写代码前，我想确认大家理解一致。

situation.zh: 跨团队会议结束前，你想确认两边对接口格式的理解是一致的。
situation.en: Before we go, are we on the same page about the API format?

entries.note: “对齐一下”最自然的口语说法。aligned 也常用：Are we aligned on this?

entries.zh: 这件事谁来负责？（o 开头的动词）

examples.en: We keep talking about the flaky tests, but who's going to own this?
examples.zh: 不稳定的测试我们说了很多次了，但这件事到底谁来负责？

situation.zh: 会上大家都同意要写一份迁移文档，但没人认领，你想问清楚负责人。
situation.en: We all agree we need a migration doc. Who's going to own this?

entries.note: own 表示对结果负责到底，不只是动手做。负责人叫 owner。

examples.en: I'll follow up with the infra team about the quota increase.
examples.zh: 配额扩容的事，我会后去找基础设施团队跟进。

situation.zh: 会上有个问题需要法务确认，你主动说会后去问。
situation.en: I'll follow up with legal and let everyone know what they say.

entries.note: follow up with 接人，follow up on 接事情。

entries.term: I'll get back to you on that.

examples.en: I don't have the numbers with me. I'll get back to you on that.
examples.zh: 数据我手头没有，这个我回头答复你。

situation.zh: 会上经理问你上个月的接口错误率，你记不清，想会后查了再答复。
situation.en: I'd have to check. I'll get back to you on that by end of day.

entries.note: 当场答不上来时的标准说法，比硬猜一个答案专业。最好带上答复的时间。

examples.en: I can take that. I already know that part of the codebase.
examples.zh: 这个我来做，那部分代码我本来就熟。

situation.zh: 经理问：谁能去查一下昨晚构建变慢的原因？你想主动认领。
situation.en: I can take that. I'll look into it this afternoon.

entries.note: 也可以说 I'll take that one.

entries.zh: 把（某人）拉进来，让其知情或参与（l 开头）

examples.en: Let's loop in the security team before we finalize the design.
examples.zh: 设计定稿之前，我们把安全团队拉进来吧。

situation.zh: 会上发现这个改动会影响数据团队，你想说会后把他们也拉进讨论。
situation.en: This affects the data team too. I'll loop them in after the meeting.

entries.note: 宾语是代词时放中间：loop them in。邮件里抄送某人时也说 Looping in Sam.

entries.term: I'll send out a summary after this.

examples.en: I'll send out a summary after this so everyone has the decisions in writing.
examples.zh: 会后我发一份总结，让大家都有书面的结论。

situation.zh: 会议结束时，你想告诉大家你会把结论和负责人整理出来发到群里。
situation.en: I'll send out a summary after this with the decisions and owners.

entries.note: send out 表示发给一群人。会议纪要叫 meeting notes，较正式的叫 minutes。

entries.zh: 回头再谈、过后再来讨论（c 开头）

examples.en: Let's circle back on this once we have the benchmark results.
examples.zh: 等基准测试结果出来，我们再回头讨论这个。

situation.zh: 会上有个问题现在缺数据定不下来，你提议下周再讨论。
situation.en: We don't have the data yet. Let's circle back next week.

entries.note: 职场套话，有人嫌它“官腔”，但确实天天听到。circle back on 接话题，circle back with 接人。

examples.en: I think we're getting sidetracked. Can we go back to the agenda?
examples.zh: 我觉得我们跑题了，能回到议程上吗？

situation.zh: 评审会上大家开始争论代码风格，你想把讨论拉回到架构问题。
situation.en: We're getting sidetracked. Let's get back to the architecture question.

entries.note: 主语用 we 不用 you，不针对个人。

examples.en: This only affects the two of us, so let's take this offline.
examples.zh: 这事只跟我们俩有关，我们会后单聊吧。

situation.zh: 站会上你和同事开始深入讨论一个 bug 的细节，其他人都在等，你想提议会后再说。
situation.en: Let's take this offline. I'll ping you after standup.

entries.note: offline 在这里不是“断网”，是“不在这个会上谈”。站会上极其常用。

examples.en: We're running out of time, so let's skip to the last item.
examples.zh: 时间快不够了，我们直接跳到最后一项吧。

situation.zh: 会议还剩五分钟，还有两个议题没讲，你想提醒大家。
situation.en: We're running out of time. Can we cover the last two items quickly?

entries.note: 也说 We're running short on time.

entries.zh: 这个先放一放。（p 开头的动词）

examples.en: Let's park that for now and come back to it if we have time.
examples.zh: 这个先放一放，有时间再回来说。

situation.zh: 讨论中有人提出一个很好但和今天主题无关的想法，你想先搁置。
situation.en: That's a good idea, but let's park that for now and focus on the release.

entries.note: park 像停车一样“先停在这儿”。先夸一句再搁置，对方不会觉得被否定。

examples.en: If there are no more questions, let's move on to the next topic.
examples.zh: 如果没有别的问题，我们进入下一个议题。

situation.zh: 你主持会议，第一个议题已经讨论完了，想进入发布计划。
situation.en: OK, let's move on to the release plan.

examples.en: I think you're on mute. We can't hear you.
examples.zh: 你好像静音了，我们听不到你说话。

situation.zh: 线上会议里同事嘴在动，但没有声音。
situation.en: Hey, you're on mute.

entries.note: 自己忘了开麦时说 Sorry, I was on mute.

entries.zh: 你们能看到我的屏幕吗？

examples.en: Can you see my screen? I just started sharing.
examples.zh: 你们能看到我的屏幕吗？我刚开始共享。

situation.zh: 你刚点了共享屏幕，想确认大家看得到。
situation.en: Can you see my screen? You should be seeing the dashboard.

examples.en: You're breaking up. Could you try turning off your video?
examples.zh: 你的声音断断续续的，要不要试试把视频关掉？

situation.zh: 同事在线上会议里讲话，声音一卡一卡的，你听不清。
situation.en: Sorry, you're breaking up. I only caught half of that.

entries.note: break up 指声音因为网络不好而断续。画面卡住不动用 frozen。

examples.en: Can you hear me OK? I'm using a new headset.
examples.zh: 你们听我说话清楚吗？我换了个新耳机。

situation.zh: 你刚进线上会议，不确定麦克风是否正常。
situation.en: Hi everyone. Can you hear me OK?

examples.en: Let me share my screen so I can walk you through the diagram.
examples.zh: 我共享一下屏幕，带大家过一遍这张图。

situation.zh: 你想给大家看报错日志，需要先共享屏幕，请大家稍等。
situation.en: Give me a second, let me share my screen.

entries.note: 停止共享是 stop sharing。

entries.zh: 你好像卡住了。（画面不动了）

examples.en: I think you're frozen. We lost you about a minute ago.
examples.zh: 你好像卡住了，大概一分钟前就断了。

situation.zh: 线上会议里同事的画面停住不动，也没声音了。
situation.en: Sam, I think you're frozen. Can you hear us?

entries.zh: 把它发到聊天框里（d 开头的动词）

examples.en: Could you drop it in the chat so everyone has the link?
examples.zh: 你能把它发到聊天框里吗？这样大家都有链接。

situation.zh: 同事在会上提到一篇设计文档，你想请他把链接发到会议聊天里。
situation.en: Could you drop it in the chat? I'd like to read it after the call.

entries.note: drop 是 post、paste 的口语说法。

examples.en: I have to drop off in five minutes for another meeting.
examples.zh: 我五分钟后得退出，还有另一个会。

situation.zh: 线上会议开到一半，你必须提前离开去开另一个会。
situation.en: Sorry, I need to drop off now. I'll catch up on the notes later.

entries.note: 也可以只说 I have to drop.

entries.zh: 到点必须结束（不能拖堂）

examples.en: I have a hard stop at three, so let's start with the most important item.
examples.zh: 我三点必须走，所以我们先说最重要的那项。

situation.zh: 会议开始时你想提前说明：你十一点整有别的安排，必须准时离开。
situation.en: Just a heads-up, I have a hard stop at eleven.

examples.en: Sorry I'm late. My last meeting ran over.
examples.zh: 抱歉我来晚了，上一个会拖堂了。

situation.zh: 你迟到了几分钟才进线上会议，原因是前一个会议没按时结束。
situation.en: Sorry, everyone. My previous call ran over.

entries.note: 过去式 ran over。也说 run long。

examples.en: Does Thursday at two work for you?
examples.zh: 周四下午两点你方便吗？

situation.zh: 你想约同事明天上午十点过一遍设计，问他行不行。
situation.en: Does ten tomorrow morning work for you?

entries.note: 回答可以说 That works. 或 Sorry, that doesn't work for me.

entries.zh: （临时）开个语音或视频聊一下

examples.en: This is getting hard to explain in chat. Can we hop on a call?
examples.zh: 这个打字说不清楚，我们开个语音聊一下？

situation.zh: 你和同事在聊天里来回讨论了二十条消息还没说清，你想直接通话。
situation.en: It might be faster to talk. Do you have five minutes to hop on a call?

entries.note: hop on 也可以换成 jump on。指临时、简短的通话。

examples.en: Let's sync up on Friday to see where we are with the migration.
examples.zh: 我们周五碰一下，看看迁移进展到哪了。

situation.zh: 你和另一个团队的同事各自做了一半，你想约个时间对一下进度。
situation.en: Can we sync up tomorrow to make sure our parts fit together?

entries.note: 名词用法：a quick sync（简短的碰头）。

examples.en: I'll send a calendar invite for Tuesday at ten.
examples.zh: 我发一个周二十点的日历邀请。

situation.zh: 你和同事口头约好了周三下午开会，你想说你来发会议邀请。
situation.en: Great, I'll send a calendar invite for Wednesday afternoon.

entries.note: invite 在这里是名词，重音在第一个音节。口语常只说 send an invite。

examples.en: Something came up. Can we move our one-on-one to tomorrow?
examples.zh: 我临时有事，我们的一对一能改到明天吗？

situation.zh: 你和同事约了下午三点讨论，但突然有紧急的事要处理，想改期。
situation.en: Sorry, something came up. Could we reschedule for tomorrow?

entries.note: 不用解释具体是什么事，对方一般不会追问。

examples.en: I'm not going to be ready by Monday. Can we push it to Wednesday?
examples.zh: 周一我准备不好，能推迟到周三吗？

situation.zh: 评审会定在今天下午，但你的文档还没写完，想改到周五。
situation.en: My doc isn't ready yet. Can we push it to Friday?

entries.note: push 指往后推；往前提是 move it up。

entries.zh: 我……（那个时间）有别的安排，撞了

examples.en: I have a conflict at two. Could we do three instead?
examples.zh: 我两点有别的安排，能改成三点吗？

situation.zh: 同事约你周四上午十点开会，但你那个时间已经有会了。
situation.en: I have a conflict at ten on Thursday. Is the afternoon OK?

entries.note: conflict 在这里指日程冲突，不是和人起冲突。
